title: PDF ko searchable AI knowledge base banao - Docling, Ollama aur Chroma
content:
Aapke paas ek bada PDF hai, aur usme se ek line dhoondhne mein AADHA GHANTA lagta hai? Aaj ye problem khatam.
Aaj main aapko step by step dikhata hoon ki ek PDF ko searchable AI knowledge base kaise banate hain.
Aur poora stack FREE AUR OPEN-SOURCE hai.
You only need 3 tools and a laptop.
Step number 1, Docling.
Ye ek open-source tool hai jo PDF ko padhta hai aur usse clean text mein badal deta hai.
Headings, tables, sections, sab structure ke saath.
This matters, because messy text gives messy answers.
Step number 2, chunking.
Poore document ko chhote chhote hisson mein todte hain, jaise har section ya har paragraph.
Kyunki AI ko poori kitaab nahi chahiye, use sirf sahi paragraph chahiye.
Ab asli magic yahan hai. Search words se nahi, MEANING SE hoga.
Step number 3, Ollama.
Ollama aapke laptop pe open models chalata hai. Ek embedding model har chunk ko numbers mein badalta hai.
Similar meaning wale chunks ke numbers bhi paas paas hote hain.
Your data stays on your own machine.
Step number 4, Chroma.
Ye open-source vector database hai. Saare chunks yahan store hote hain.
Aap sawaal poochte ho, Chroma sabse relevant chunks nikaalta hai, aur Ollama wala model unhi se jawab likhta hai.
The answer comes from your PDF, NOT FROM THE MODEL'S MEMORY.
Maan lo aap ek support team mein ho, aur aapke paas 300 page ka product manual hai.
Customer poochta hai, "Warranty claim kaise karun?"
Knowledge base seedha sahi section nikaal deta hai, page number ke saath.
Ab support agent ko manual yaad karne ki zaroorat nahi.
Ek pro tip. Har jawab ke saath source chunk bhi dikhao.
Isse user khud check kar sakta hai ki answer sahi hai ya nahi.
Trust is what makes people actually use it.
Mera take simple hai.
Har company ke paas PDFs ka pahaad hai. Jo insaan ise searchable bana sakta hai, uski DEMAND HAMESHA RAHEGI.
Ye project aapke portfolio mein sabse strong cheez ban sakta hai.
